judged.play: Vora gets a multi-kill through smoke while completely blind on an eco round
judged.reason: The impressive multi-kill blind spray combined with his hilarious sandwich-and-drink celebration makes this the best play reaction of the stream.

judged.play: 100 Thieves win a round, followed by replay highlight
judged.reason: His signature shout and dance are energetic, but it is a fairly routine round win compared to the top highlights.

judged.play: Chaotic utility dump and firefight on C site
judged.reason: The play is messy utility usage without a standout individual multi-kill or clutch.

judged.play: 100 Thieves lose a round due to a friendly flash accident
judged.reason: While his frustration is genuine, standard round losses like this happen frequently across the stream.

judged.play: Streamer encourages the team during crowd replay
judged.reason: This is basic filler dialogue between rounds with no gameplay happening on screen.

judged.play: 100 Thieves tie up the match 3-3 on defense
judged.reason: A generic round win callout that repeats many times throughout the stream.

judged.play: Tech pause occurs on stage and streamer observes players warming their hands
judged.reason: It is downtime banter during a technical pause without any action.

judged.play: Streamer analyzes Bang's confident player movement during a tech pause
judged.line: He moves like he's the best in the lobby
judged.reason: Good commentary beat about player mental, but lacks a live gameplay play to back it up.

judged.play: Streamer praises player Timotino for staying positive after a lost round
judged.reason: Routine positive commentary between rounds without an exciting highlight play.

judged.play: Chaotic site defense featuring a shorty kill and a successful defuse clutch
judged.line: I don't even know how the other guy died, but we don't care!
judged.reason: His confused, triumphant reaction to the chaotic final defuse kill stands out as a memorable moment.

judged.play: Replay showing LOUD setting up a three-player stack
judged.reason: Standard replay breakdown of an opponent setup without significant hype or play quality.

judged.play: Streamer complains about and physically acts out the long delay on Neon's stun
judged.line: I feel like the Neon stun is so late!
judged.reason: His funny physical dance and sound effects mimicking the slow stun animation make this a uniquely funny non-play moment.

judged.play: 100 Thieves hold down C site to secure the round win
judged.reason: A solid defense win, but his reaction is identical to many other standard round wins in the stream.
